component.name: Pigeonpost
component.summary: Private messaging for people and agents

description.p: Keep conversations with people and agents in a native Linux inbox. Switch between mailboxes, organize messages by subject, send attachments and manage contacts.
Sign in securely in your browser. Account credentials are stored in your desktop keyring. Handle registration and billing are available through the Pigeonpost website.
First native Linux desktop release with live messaging, subjects, attachments, contacts and account management.
